instructions: This visually stunning rice dish is secretly super easy to make!
Ingredients Fried Rice Ingredients Chicken Marinade Red Sauce White Sauce
Wash & cook rice First, wash the rice (12 oz) 3 times in clean water.
Then, add water (13 oz) to the rice and cook in your rice cooker.
Prepare eggs, tomato, & onion Separate the eggs (3 ) into two bowls, one for yolks, and the other for whites.
Cut the tomato (1 ) in quarters, and cut and discard the hard stem. Then, cut the tomato core away from the wall, and roughly dice into small pieces.
Cut the rest of the tomato into two ways: cut half of them into small strips, and dice the rest.
Cut the onion (1 oz) in two different ways: cut half into small strips, and dice the rest.
Prepare shrimp & chicken Cut the shrimp (5 oz) in half, lengthwise, so they still look like whole shrimp from one side but are half the thickness.
Cut the chicken breast (15 oz) in half horizontally to halve the thickness, and then slice into short strips.
Then, marinate the chicken with salt (0.50 tsp), cornstarch (1 tbsp), and water (2 tbsp).
Create red sauce In a medium-sized bowl, mix together ketchup (3 tbsp), sugar (2 tbsp), vinegar (1 tbsp), salt (1 tsp), and chicken broth (6 oz). Have a taste and adjust the flavors to your liking.
Fold foil & prepare rice Tear out a piece of aluminum foil, at least 1.5 the diameter of your serving dish. Fold it in half lengthwise, curve it into an S shape, and set it aside for later.
Mix the egg yolks into the steamed rice.
Fry rice Heat the wok on high for about a minute on the highest heat. Then, add oil (1 tbsp), give it a quick swirl, and add the rice in. Fry the rice on high for about 3 minutes.
Season the fried rice with salt (0.50 tsp), mix it in, and cook for another 30-40 seconds. Scoop the rice into your serving plate and gentle pat it down so it's level.
Stir-fry red side Reheat the wok on high for another 30 seconds, then add the oil (1 tbsp). Add the chicken and stir-fry for about 30-40 seconds.

Push the chicken to the side of the wok, and add the sliced onion. Stir-fry the onions a bit and add the diced tomato core and pieces, pressing the juice out with the spatula. Add the tomato strips as well, and stir-fry for 40-50 seconds.
Add the red sauce that we mixed up earlier. Lower the heat, and give it a taste, and adjust to your liking.
Then, prepare the slurry by mixing cornstarch (1 tbsp) and water (2 tbsp) in a separate bowl. Pour the mixed slurry into the red sauce, stirring constantly to prevent clumping.
Stir-fry white side Either use a separate wok and spatula, or give your set-up a quick clean so that there's no residue of the red sauce.
Heat the wok on high for about a minute, and add oil (2 tbsp). Put the shrimp in, turn the heat down to low, and cook the shrimp for about 20 seconds.
Add the minced onion and stir-fry for 20 seconds. Then add chicken broth and salt.
Mix another slurry with cornstarch (1 tbsp) and water (2 tbsp) in a small bowl.
Beat the egg whites really well to incorporate some air and volume into it.
Now, add the slurry while stirring constantly. Make and add more cornstarch slurry if necessary.
Next, pour the egg whites slowly, circling over the surface a few times. Don't stir it yet! Let the egg whites cook for 20-30 seconds, and turn off the heat.
Add oil (1 tsp) for shine and sprinkle on peas (2 oz) for color. Stir the peas in so the heat can cook them just a bit.

Plate & serve Put your aluminum mold on top of the prepared fried rice. Scoop the red sauce onto one side of the mold, and the white sauce on the other side. Gently remove the mold by pulling it straight up.
Enjoy!
Take pictures Whip out your camera (1). Begin taking photos (1,000,000). Pick your favorites!

instructions: Prep tin 43x28 that has a shallow edge Grease tin Line tin with greaseproof paper that has corner squares cut to push corners into tin grease the paper whisk in 120g caster sugar to 6 egg yolks mixture should be pale and thick sieve in 50g cocoa powder and a pinch of salt fold to make a thick paste stir in ½ tsp vanilla, then leave to the side whisk 6 egg whites in a different bowl until soft peaks form gradually add in 30g caster sugar and keep whisking the eggs until stiff peaks incorporate two mixtures by adding a scoop of egg white into chocolate mixture with a large metal spoon quite vigorously to loosen the chocolate batter then fold gently in half of remainder egg white at a time, cut through the middle fold in the sides, twice.until white flecks disappear preheat oven to 190° (170° fan assisted) pour mixture into pan and spread batter leveling carefully to not knock air out bake for 10 minutes check if cooked by poking sponge and it bounces back let sponge cool for 2 minutes dust some icing sugar onto tea towel spread out flat flip the sponge onto the dusted towel remove the tin and gently peel off greaseproof paper to avoid cracks roll tea towel before incorporating the sponge Leave the sponge to cool down completely Ganache Add 100g butter into bowl of 200g chocolate chips and microwave Mix in 100g double cream Cool down completely either room temperature or fridge, mixing frequently to cool down evenly
